description: This file contains utility classes and functions for testing reporting components in the Chromium project, including mock implementations of uploaders, delegates, and context setup for testing reporting features.

classes.name: PendingUploadImpl
classes.description: A mock implementation of a pending upload used in testing reporting upload behavior.

classes.name: TestReportingUploader
classes.description: A mock reporting uploader for testing, managing a list of pending uploads.

classes.name: TestReportingDelegate
classes.description: A mock reporting delegate for testing report permissions and behaviors.

classes.name: TestReportingContext
classes.description: A test setup for reporting context, including timers and store management.

classes.name: ReportingTestBase
classes.description: Base class providing utilities for testing reporting features, including cache and endpoint management.

classes.name: TestReportingService
classes.description: A mock reporting service for testing report queuing and lifecycle management.

methods.name: TestReportingRandIntCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback that generates pseudo-random integers within a range for testing.

methods.name: StartUpload
methods.description: Simulates starting an upload in the mock uploader, storing the pending upload.

methods.name: OnShutdown
methods.description: Clears pending uploads or performs cleanup on shutdown.

methods.name: GetPendingUploadCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns the number of pending uploads in the mock uploader.

methods.name: CanQueueReport
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating reports can be queued.

methods.name: CanSendReports
methods.description: Simulates permission check for sending reports, with optional pausing.

methods.name: PermissionsCheckPaused
methods.description: Returns whether permission check is paused.

methods.name: ResumePermissionsCheck
methods.description: Resumes permission check callback.

methods.name: CanSetClient
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating client can be set.

methods.name: CanUseClient
methods.description: Always returns true, indicating client can be used.

methods.name: CreateContext
methods.description: Creates a new reporting context with specified policy and time.

methods.name: UsePolicy
methods.description: Updates the context with a new reporting policy.

methods.name: UseStore
methods.description: Sets the store used in the context and recreates it.

methods.name: FindEndpointInCache
methods.description: Retrieves an endpoint from the cache based on group key and URL.

methods.name: SetEndpointInCache
methods.description: Sets an endpoint in the cache with specified parameters.

methods.name: SetV1EndpointInCache
methods.description: Sets a V1 endpoint in the cache.

methods.name: EndpointExistsInCache
methods.description: Checks if an endpoint exists in the cache.

methods.name: GetEndpointStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a specific endpoint.

methods.name: EndpointGroupExistsInCache
methods.description: Checks if an endpoint group exists in the cache.

methods.name: ClientExistsInCacheForOrigin
methods.description: Checks if a client exists in cache for a given origin.

methods.name: MakeURL
methods.description: Generates a test URL based on an index.

methods.name: SimulateRestart
methods.description: Simulates a restart by advancing time.
